header.purpose: Machine-readable unified TrustedExecutionReceipt contract. The native ExecutionReceipt (Rust ExecutionReceipt in desktop-daemon/src-tauri/src/execution_broker/readback/types.rs) is the process lifecycle authority; the Brain narrow TrustedExecutionReceipt (brain-server/src/outcome/contracts.ts) consumes exactly the fields declared here through the trusted NativeReceiptResolver. A caller can never construct a receipt: production path is receipt_id -> trusted internal NativeReceiptResolver -> native persistent ReceiptStore -> validated narrow TrustedExecutionReceipt snapshot -> OutcomeService.
header.digest_authority: receipt_digest is a NATIVE integrity/audit field. Real trust comes from the NativeReceiptResolver resolving against the persistent native ReceiptStore, NOT from a caller-provided digest. The Brain core recomputes receipt_digest over the canonical content (sorted keys, strict number domain, SHA-256 lowercase hex) and rejects on mismatch - mutation detection, not authority transfer.
header.digest_canonicalization: SHA-256 lowercase hex over canonical JSON: object keys sorted, arrays order-preserving, JSON.stringify string escaping, strict shared number domain (finite, abs <= 9007199254740991, fixed-point, <= 6 fractional digits). Both languages share this definition (Brain evidence/model.ts canonicalJson, Rust execution_broker/approval/digest.rs).

receipt_id.authority: native-generated (rcpt_ + 32 random hex); caller can never submit one
receipt_id.semantic: primary key of the persistent native ReceiptStore

plan_id.authority: copied from the approved ExecutionPlan at accept time; immutable
plan_id.semantic: exactly one approved plan per receipt

decision_id.authority: copied from the approved plan; immutable

capability_id.authority: copied from the approved plan; immutable

capability_version.authority: copied from the approved plan; immutable

adapter_id.authority: copied from the approved plan; immutable

normalized_inputs_digest.authority: native-computed over the approved normalized_inputs; Brain recomputes and compares
normalized_inputs_digest.semantic: the executed inputs can never drift after approval

verification_plan_digest.authority: native-computed over the full approved verification_plan object (CP7 approval-binding definition); absent for plans without a verification plan; Brain recomputes and compares
verification_plan_digest.semantic: verification capability + verification inputs are frozen at execution time

execution_state.authority: derived ONLY via the shared execution-state mapping from the native receipt lifecycle (accepted/spawn_started/completed/spawn_failed/unknown_after_crash + exit_code/timed_out/cancelled flags)
execution_state.semantic: process lifecycle knowledge; NEVER business outcome truth

accepted_at.authority: trusted native clock at durable accepted write
accepted_at.semantic: receipt creation instant; all later timestamps must be >= accepted_at

spawn_started_at.authority: trusted native clock at durable spawn marker
spawn_started_at.semantic: proof the OS process was created; absent for not_started and recovered-from-accepted unknown_after_crash

finished_at.authority: trusted native clock at completion write
finished_at.semantic: lifecycle completion instant; absent for in-flight and crash states

exit_code.semantic: spawn fact only; exit 0 can NEVER verify an external effect

timed_out.semantic: broker timeout; effect may still have occurred

cancelled.semantic: broker cancellation; effect may still have occurred

receipt_digest.authority: native integrity/audit field over the digest_covered fields; Brain recomputes for mutation detection only

source.authority: constant; any other value is rejected
source.semantic: receipts can only originate from the native broker

trust_rules: exit_code == 0, BrokerExecutionResult.success == true, ExecutionPlan.state == succeeded, stdout containing 'success', stderr absence, approval granted, LLM claims, skill claims and evidence notes can NEVER produce Outcome.verification_status = verified
only a trusted native read-back observation + a trusted deterministic Brain evaluator can produce verified
BrokerExecutionResult has NO Deserialize implementation (compile-time enforced, CP8A-002): caller JSON can never be deserialized into a receipt-looking value
no public submitReceipt / registerReceipt / POST /receipt / MCP receipt tool / WebView receipt import exists

ExecutionPlan.succeeded = process/execution lifecycle succeeded (NOT business outcome verified); ExecutionPlan.failed = lifecycle failed (NOT external effect definitely absent) - frozen with regression tests
